title: Spurious Rewards: Rethinking Training Signals in RLVR
authors_zh: Rulin Shao, Shuyue Stella Li, Rui Xin, Scott Geng, Yiping Wang, Sewoong Oh, Simon Shaolei Du, Nathan Lambert, Sewon Min, Ranjay Krishna, Yulia Tsvetkov, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Pang Wei Koh, Luke Zettlemoyer
paper_type_zh: RLVR 奖励信号与优化机制审计论文
best_for_zh: 需要判断 RLVR 增益是否真由奖励信息带来、或准备复现数学推理强化学习的人。
one_line: Controlled RLVR audit showing that GRPO can raise Qwen math scores under random or incorrect rewards by amplifying pretrained behaviors, while the effect often fails outside Qwen.
受控审计显示：GRPO 可在随机或错误奖励下放大 Qwen 的既有推理行为并提高数学分数，但这一效应常无法迁移到其他模型家族。
why: It makes random and format-only reward baselines, model-family transfer, and optimizer details necessary checks before interpreting an RLVR gain as new reasoning ability.
inclusion_reason: Controlled RLVR audit showing that apparent reasoning gains can arise from GRPO's amplification of useful pretrained behaviors rather than informative rewards.

title: Problem
问题
html:
RLVR gains on mathematical reasoning are often attributed to correct verifiable rewards, yet this leaves open whether the reward itself teaches the capability. If random or wrong feedback can produce the same score increase, a Qwen-only evaluation can misidentify optimizer- or prior-driven behavior as a new reasoning method.

The paper performs a controlled reward-signal audit: it holds the GRPO training setup fixed while replacing answer correctness with majority-vote, format, random, and deliberately incorrect rewards. It then tests whether the resulting gain transfers across Qwen2.5, Llama3, and OLMo2 families.

The target is an interpretation failure in post-training evaluation, not merely a weaker-label recipe: an apparent improvement must be separated from behavior already present before RL.

The practical output is an audit protocol for causal claims about reward quality.

数学推理中的 RLVR 增益常被归因于正确的可验证奖励，但这不能证明奖励本身教会了能力。若随机或错误反馈也能带来近似涨分，只在 Qwen 上评估就可能把优化器或预训练先验驱动的行为误认成新的推理方法。

论文进行受控奖励信号审计：固定 GRPO 训练设置，将答案正确性依次替换为多数投票、格式、随机和刻意错误奖励；再比较所得增益能否迁移到 Qwen2.5、Llama3 与 OLMo2 模型家族。

它针对的是后训练评估的归因失误，而不只是寻找更弱标签：任何表面改进都须与 RL 前已经存在的行为区分开来。

实际产出是一套审计奖励质量因果主张的检查协议。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a counterfactual RLVR audit showing that GRPO can amplify useful, high-prior pretrained behavior without informative reward: Qwen2.5-Math's code-style reasoning is one observable case. This reframes a score gain as evidence about the interaction of optimizer, base-model prior, and reward—not automatically about reward quality or new capability.

The authors release the training code plus filtered and majority-labeled DeepScaleR variants in the repository's code/data directory. The released records support reproduction of the reward conditions; no separate dataset card or independent data license is disclosed.

The diagnostic output is thus a matched family of reward-conditioned checkpoints and evaluation traces, rather than a claim that every pretrained pattern is beneficial.

Its central unit of analysis is a behavior-and-score pair under a fixed training recipe.

核心贡献是一项反事实 RLVR 审计：GRPO 即使没有信息性奖励，也会放大预训练中高先验且有用的行为；Qwen2.5-Math 的代码式推理是可观察案例。因此，分数上涨应被视为优化器、基础模型先验与奖励交互的证据，而非自动证明奖励质量或新增能力。

作者公开训练代码，并在仓库 code/data 提供过滤版和多数投票标注的 DeepScaleR 变体，足以复现各奖励条件；未找到独立数据集卡或单独的数据许可。

因此诊断产物是可配对比较的奖励条件 checkpoint 与评测轨迹，并非声称所有预训练行为都会带来收益。

其核心分析单元是在固定训练配方下同时观察行为与分数。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define counterfactual rewards. Start with DeepScaleR math prompts and replace answer-equivalence feedback by a 64-rollout majority pseudo-label, non-empty boxed-answer format, Bernoulli random reward, or a selected wrong majority label; each rollout receives binary feedback.
  1. Train matched policies. Use GRPO to generate 16 online rollouts per prompt, normalize group-relative advantages, and update the same base model. Main runs use Qwen2.5-Math-7B; the intended output is a checkpoint under each reward condition, not a new reasoning dataset.
  1. Test transfer. Keep the setup and reward menu while training Qwen2.5, Llama3, and OLMo2 variants, then evaluate MATH-500 pass@1 and AMC/AIME avg@8. This makes base-model family the decisive comparison rather than a changed data recipe.
  1. Isolate the mechanism. Remove or neutralize GRPO clipping through three no-clipping variants, then track token probability and Python-string frequency. The check is whether random-reward gains persist; they do so consistently only with clipping enabled.

Reproduction needs the released code and data directory, exact model/chat template, GRPO clipping implementation, 300-step budget, and decoding settings. Main training uses 8 A100s, learning rate 5e-7, rollout batch 64, minibatch 128, no KL/entropy loss; seed coverage is limited.

1. 构造反事实奖励。以 DeepScaleR 数学题为输入，将答案等价反馈替换为 64 次采样的多数伪标签、非空 boxed 答案格式、伯努利随机奖励或选定的错误多数标签；每条 rollout 得到二元反馈。
  1. 训练可比策略。用 GRPO 为每题在线生成 16 条 rollout，归一化组相对优势并更新同一基础模型。主实验为 Qwen2.5-Math-7B；产物是各奖励条件下的 checkpoint，而非新推理数据集。
  1. 检验跨族迁移。保持训练设置和奖励菜单，改训 Qwen2.5、Llama3 与 OLMo2 变体，再测 MATH-500 的 pass@1 及 AMC/AIME 的 avg@8；决定性比较是模型家族，而非换了数据配方。
  1. 分离机制。通过三种无裁剪变体移除或中和 GRPO clipping，同时跟踪 token 概率与 Python 字符串频率；检查随机奖励涨分是否仍在，结果显示只有启用裁剪时才稳定出现。

复现须固定公开代码和数据目录、模型/chat template、GRPO 裁剪实现、300 步预算及解码设置。主训练用 8 张 A100、学习率 5e-7、rollout batch 64、minibatch 128，不用 KL/熵损失；随机种子覆盖有限。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, large RLVR gains need not come from correct labels. With the same 300-step GRPO setup and DeepScaleR prompts, MATH-500 pass@1 rises by 29.1 points with ground truth, but also by 24.1 with an incorrect majority label and 21.4 with Bernoulli(0.5) random reward (Fig. 1–2).

Mechanism check: random-reward training gives consistent gains only when GRPO clipping is present; three variants that remove or neutralize clipping do not (Fig. 4). The authors connect this to Qwen2.5-Math-7B's code reasoning rising from 65% before RL to above 90% under spurious rewards (Fig. 6; Table 1).

The result supports a configuration-specific amplification account, not that random feedback teaches mathematics: the same spurious rewards are usually flat or harmful for Llama3 and OLMo2 (Fig. 3), and prompts also affect the Qwen starting point.

On the post-cutoff AIME 2025 check, ground truth has a clearer advantage, while other rewards yield only -0.4 to +4.5 points; this further narrows the claim.

主张是：在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上，大幅 RLVR 增益未必来自正确标签。相同 DeepScaleR 提示和 300 步 GRPO 下，MATH-500 pass@1 使用真值涨 29.1 点，使用错误多数标签仍涨 24.1 点，使用 Bernoulli(0.5) 随机奖励也涨 21.4 点（图 1–2）。

机制检验显示：随机奖励只有在 GRPO 保留 clipping 时才稳定涨分；三种移除或中和裁剪的变体都不成立（图 4）。作者将其联系到 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的代码式推理频率从训练前 65% 升至伪奖励下超过 90%（图 6、表 1）。

这支持特定配置下的放大解释，不能证明随机反馈教会数学：同样的伪奖励在 Llama3 与 OLMo2 上通常无效或有害（图 3），且提示词也会改变 Qwen 的起点。

在知识截止后编写的 AIME 2025 检查中，真值奖励优势更清楚，其余奖励仅为 −0.4 到 +4.5 点，进一步收窄了结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Closest weak-supervision RLVR methods replace labels with majority voting, formatting, or one-shot signals, but a gain there can still be read as evidence that the surrogate carries useful task information. This paper deliberately extends the control to Bernoulli noise and selected wrong labels, while holding GRPO and data fixed and testing multiple model families.

Its novelty is therefore the counterfactual reward audit plus a clipping ablation that ties the anomaly to amplification of a pretrained behavior. It does not introduce a new reward for deployment; the released data and code support diagnosis and reproduction.

The changed experimental decision is to use deliberately uninformative or anti-correctness controls, not to introduce a new base model, benchmark, or final-answer verifier.

This changes the evidentiary bar for future weak-reward claims.

最接近的弱监督 RLVR 会以多数投票、格式或单样本信号替代标签，但其涨分仍可能被理解为代理信号携带了有用任务信息。本文把对照推进到伯努利噪声和选定错误标签，同时固定 GRPO 与数据，并跨多个模型家族测试。

真正的新意是反事实奖励审计，以及把异常连接到预训练行为放大的 clipping 消融。它并未提出可部署的新奖励；公开数据与代码的用途是诊断和复现。

被改变的实验决策是引入刻意无信息或反正确性的对照，而不是提出新的基础模型、benchmark 或最终答案 verifier。

这也提高了后续弱奖励主张所需的证据门槛。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated boundary: random and incorrect rewards are analytical controls, not a capability-training recipe; outside Qwen2.5 they often fail or harm performance. Treat a Qwen-only score gain as insufficient evidence and rerun the matched reward controls on at least one non-Qwen family.

Mechanism boundary: the clipping analysis and ablations target this GRPO configuration with no KL or entropy loss. Before extending the explanation to another RL algorithm, template, or optimizer setting, reproduce the no-clipping control and log both behavior frequency and accuracy.

Curator audit risk: the public repository includes filtered/majority-labeled data, but no separate data card or independent data license was found. Check upstream DeepScaleR terms and exact file provenance before redistribution.

The paper also reports prompt sensitivity for Qwen2.5-Math-7B; pin and disclose the chat template before comparing baseline and post-RL scores.

作者明确的边界是：随机和错误奖励只是分析对照，并非能力训练配方；在 Qwen2.5 外它们常失效或伤害表现。不能把只在 Qwen 上的涨分当作充分证据，至少应在一个非 Qwen 家族重跑配对奖励对照。

机制边界是：clipping 分析与消融针对不含 KL、熵损失的这套 GRPO 配置。外推到另一 RL 算法、template 或优化器前，应复现无裁剪对照，并同时记录行为频率和准确率。

策展审计风险是：公开仓库含过滤/多数标注数据，但未见独立数据卡或单独许可；再分发前需检查上游 DeepScaleR 条款及每个文件的来源。

论文还报告 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 对提示词敏感；比较基线与 RL 后分数前，必须固定并披露 chat template。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For an RLVR researcher diagnosing a math-training gain, reuse the released scripts and code/data reward variants on a fixed prompt set and base model. Train ground-truth, format, random, and incorrect-label controls with matched steps, then output a comparison report containing accuracy, response format, and the targeted behavior frequency.

For an optimizer study, reproduce the clipping/no-clipping ablation and inspect whether a high-prior behavior—not just a score—changes with the update. Success means the pattern survives seed and model-family checks; do not use this recipe as a production reward or for tasks without a separately validated correctness/evaluation protocol.

For a benchmark report, publish the matched controls, templates, decoding budget, and per-family outcomes beside the headline score, so readers can audit the causal interpretation.

若要诊断数学训练中的 RLVR 增益，可在固定提示集和基础模型上复用公开脚本及 code/data 奖励变体。以相同步数训练真值、格式、随机与错误标签对照，输出包含准确率、回答格式和目标行为频率的比较报告。

若研究优化器，可复现有/无 clipping 消融，检查更新改变的是否是高先验行为而不只是分数。只有模式经随机种子和模型家族检查后仍成立才算成功；不要把该配方用于生产奖励，或直接用于缺少独立正确性/评测协议的任务。

若撰写 benchmark 报告，应把配对对照、template、解码预算和各模型家族结果与主分数一并公开，让读者审计因果归因。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: random or wrong RLVR rewards can raise Qwen2.5-Math scores, so a reward-driven capability claim needs counterfactual controls.
  1. Lever: hold GRPO and DeepScaleR fixed, vary only binary reward, then compare Qwen2.5 with Llama3/OLMo2; clipping is the quality-critical optimizer detail.
  1. Artifact: the official repository releases code and filtered/majority-labeled DeepScaleR files under code/data, but no separate dataset card or data license.
  1. Evidence anchor: on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, random reward gains +21.4 MATH-500 points versus +29.1 for ground truth; no-clipping variants lose the stable effect, and this is only an audit clue, not a cross-family capability gain.
  1. Reuse decision: use it to audit an RLVR result, not to select a reward. Before reuse, run matched random/format controls on a non-Qwen family, verify upstream data terms, and keep the chat template and decoding temperature fixed because the Qwen2.5-Math-7B baseline is prompt-sensitive.

1. 定位：随机或错误 RLVR 奖励也能提高 Qwen2.5-Math 分数，因此“奖励带来能力”的主张必须有反事实对照。
  1. 抓手：固定 GRPO 与 DeepScaleR，只改变二元奖励，再比较 Qwen2.5 和 Llama3/OLMo2；clipping 是决定质量的优化器细节。
  1. Artifact：官方仓库公开代码及 code/data 下的过滤/多数标注 DeepScaleR 文件，但未见独立数据卡或数据许可。
  1. 证据：Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的随机奖励在 MATH-500 涨 21.4 点，真值奖励涨 29.1 点；无裁剪变体失去稳定效应，仅是审计线索，不能据此证明跨模型家族的能力增长。
  1. 决定：适合审计 RLVR 结果，不适合挑选生产奖励；复用前要在非 Qwen 家族跑配对随机/格式对照、核验上游数据条款，并固定 chat template 与解码温度，因为 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 基线对提示词敏感。
